newsitem.title: USA: Children's stake held by chairman.
newsitem.headline: Children's stake held by chairman.

text.p: Christopher Dahl, chairman and chief executive officer of Children's Broadcasting Corp, said Tuesday he holds a 9.4 percent stake in the company of 527,252 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dahl said he holds the stake in the Minneapolis, Minn., company for investment purposes.
No other details regarding the acquisition of the stake was disclosed in the document.
Children's Broadcasting Corp produces a programming mix of news, stories and games on radio stations in eight major U.S. markets.
